research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: every document is from Bank Jatim's own site www.bankjatim.co.id (Sucuri proxy, no challenge; plain curl with a browser User-Agent) except the dividend schedules (KSEI announcements on web.ksei.co.id) and one news item (FY2025 payout %). The Indonesian AR2020 and AR2021 links on the IR page return an empty file; their English editions (linked on the English IR page) were used. No Internet Archive copies were needed.

SCOPE / KUB CONSOLIDATION (most important): Bank Jatim had no subsidiaries until 2024. Under the OJK KUB (Kelompok Usaha Bank) scheme it took small stakes (new capital of roughly Rp100bn each) and, through shareholder agreements, control of: Bank NTB Syariah (NTBS, 4.09% at entry, consolidated from 23 Oct 2024), Bank NTT (BNTT, 3.23%, from 14 Dec 2025), Bank Sultra (BSTR, from 23 Dec 2025) and Bank Lampung (BLAM, 5.42% at entry, from 24 Dec 2025) (FS2025 Note 42, PDF pp. 142-150; stakes at 30 Sep 2026: 3.80% / 3.23% / 3.26% / 5.28%, FS9M2026 Note 1c PDF p. 14). Bank Banten (BEKS) joined the KUB (capital contribution Nov 2025) but is accounted as an associate, not consolidated (PSAK 110; FS2025 PDF p. 97). Because Bank Jatim owns only ~3-5%, non-controlling interests are huge (NCI 8,849bn vs total equity 22,499bn at FY2025) and most subsidiary profit goes to NCI (9M2026: 763.6bn NCI vs 1,096.1bn parent). FY2019-FY2023 = Bank Jatim alone; FY2024 = + NTBS (balance sheet; ~2 months of P&L); FY2025 = all four on the balance sheet but only ~1 month of BNTT/BSTR/BLAM P&L; 9M2026 = all four for the full period; 9M2025 comparative = NTBS only. Loan/deposit/asset growth 2023->2024, 2024->2025 and 9M25->9M26 is dominated by consolidation (bank-only loans actually FELL 2.4% YoY at 9M26: 66,547 vs 68,180, 3Q26 deck slide 18). The page's computed growth and average-equity ROE should be read with this in mind.

NO RESTATEMENTS of FY2020-FY2025 headline figures were found: each later FS repeats the prior-year totals (FS2022 and FS2024 carry a third 'opening' column for presentation re-classifications only; FS2022 split sharia funds into 'dana syirkah temporer' without changing totals). FY2019 WAS restated in FS2020 Note 57 (defined-benefit pension): total assets 76,715.290 -> 76,756.313, total equity 9,185.652 -> 9,021.558, profit unchanged; fy.2019 stores the originals (restated in notes).

DEPOSITS DEFINITION: fy.*.deposits and interim deposits = customer deposits INCLUDING temporary syirkah (mudharabah) customer deposits, i.e. Bank Jatim's own 'Dana Pihak Ketiga' (DPK) - the figure its decks print and its LDR uses. Each value is a printed total (FS face to FY2021, FS liquidity-risk note from FY2022 when the FS began showing syirkah funds separately). This keeps one definition across the 2022 presentation change and includes the sharia subsidiary NTBS's funds. (BBNI/BBTN in this dataset exclude syirkah; PNBN/BTPS include it.) Syirkah amounts: 2019-2021 inside the face line; 2022 1,841.692; 2023 2,347.055; 2024 14,958.773; 2025 17,304.800; 9M2026 17,299.999.

EQUITY ATTRIBUTABLE: the audited consolidated FS (FY2024, FY2025, 9M2026) print no 'equity attributable to owners' subtotal. equity_attr for those dates is the printed 'TOTAL EKUITAS YANG DAPAT DIATRIBUSIKAN KEPADA PEMILIK' (KONSOLIDASI column) of the OJK-format published statement (same approach as BTPS). It differs from PSAK total equity - NCI by the 'selisih transaksi dengan kepentingan non-pengendali' line: FY2025 13,656.442 vs 13,650.229; 9M2026 13,477.839 vs 13,446.439; FY2024 identical (12,512.592). The Dec-2024 published statement itself printed 12,526.689 (it added the NCI's 14.1bn profit share to parent equity); the FY2025 publication's comparative column (12,512.592, = audited) is stored.

RATIOS: all ratios are BANK ONLY as Bank Jatim reports them (OJK published-ratio definitions): ROE/ROA/NIM/NPL/LDR/CAR(KPMM individual)/CIR/BOPO from the AR five-year table (AR2025 for 2021-2025, AR2024 for 2020; cross-checked against AR2020, the decks and the OJK published ratio tables - no differences). CASA from the AR peer table (2023-2025) or the FY decks (2020-2022); coverage, credit cost and LaR from the FY analyst decks (FY2023-FY2025 coverage/CoC from the FY2025 deck's quarterly table, which the 3Q26 deck repeats as '(Bank Only)'). Interim ratios from the 9M2026 OJK published ratio table, plus CASA/coverage/CoC from the 3Q26 deck. CIR CAUTION: Bank Jatim's printed 'Cost to Income Ratio' (OJK format; 36.85% FY2025) is far below a conventional CIR; the decks' own 'CIR' was 54.95% (FY2020) and 55.02% (FY2021), and the AR's 'Rasio Efisiensi Biaya' 48-53%. The stored value is the AR/OJK one (consistent FY and interim).
LOAN AT RISK: printed only in the FY2020-FY2022 decks (6.10 / 6.57 / 4.81). FY2023-FY2025 and 9M2026 are null (not disclosed anywhere checked).

DIVIDENDS: one final cash dividend per fiscal year, no interim or special dividends (each statement of changes in equity shows one payment per year; AR2025 p. 334 table). Payout base is the PARENT-ENTITY net profit (e.g. FY2024 Rp1,281,116m vs consolidated attributable 1,281,718m); with the consolidated figure the payout check is still within 0.05%. Dates are from KSEI's schedule notices (web.ksei.co.id/Announcement/Files/BJTM_DIV_<recording date>_ID.pdf); totals from AR2025 p. 334 (FY2020-FY2024) and the AGMS 2026 minutes (FY2025). AGMS dates: 3 May 2021, 17 Mar 2022, 12 Apr 2023, 7 Feb 2024, 22 May 2025, 6 May 2026. FY2025 payment: AGMS minutes say 4 Jun 2026, KSEI notice 5 Jun 2026 (stored). FY2025 payout 55% is from news (Kontan); the company documents give only the amounts (55.00% of parent profit). No FY2026 interim dividend announced (none in the 9M2026 FS).

CORPORATE ACTIONS: none to record for 2019-2026 - no split, reverse split, rights issue or bonus issue since the IPO of 12 Jul 2012 (AR2025 p. 28 'tidak melakukan Aksi Korporasi... pemecahan saham, penggabungan saham, dividen saham, saham bonus...'; p. 154 share-issuance chronology lists only the IPO and MESOP exercises). The only share-count changes were MESOP exercises (13,127,500 new Series B shares 2016-2020; last window 3 Feb-16 Mar 2020): 14,993,772,982 shares at 30 Sep/31 Dec 2019 -> 15,015,498,082 since Q1 2020. MESOP is not a schema corporate-action type. Shares outstanding have been 15,015,498,082 with no treasury shares from FY2020 to 9M2026. No rights/bonus before 2020-12-31, so no fy.2019.year_end_price is stored (AR2020 prints the 2019 Q4 close as 655 for reference).
